address: Cumhuriyet, Tavukçu Fethi Sokak No:28/B, Şişli, Istanbul, 34380, Türkiye
bio: The long queue of locals that forms before opening time speaks volumes – this bustling place is hugely popular. So, be sure to arrive on time and you will be handsomely rewarded with a generous menu featuring expertly prepared Turkish classics. Options include an intense lahmacun with lamb, black Urfa chilli and fresh herbs, a salad that balances spicy, zesty and sweet nuances, and dolmasi with a filling of lamb, beef, rice and herbs. Deciding will not be easy, but you are bound to leave sated thanks to the outstanding value for money. A cherished spot that has truly earned its praise!
